title: DNA extraction of water sample from sylphium filters
author: Omneya Osman
materials: Luer slot of the QIAvac 24 Plus
Luer slot closed with luer plug

steps.title: Collect water sample and lyse filter
steps.instruction: Assemble the sampling kit (sylphium filter, gloves, ATL buffer, 50 mL syringe). Choose an environmental site, filter 1–3 L of water through the sylphium filter using a sterile beaker and the syringe, then inject 3 mL ATL buffer (Qiagen) into the filter. Store the filter at room temperature until laboratory receipt, then keep at 4 °C. Incubate the filter at 56 °C for 30 min to dissolve ATL crystals. Transfer the lysate from the filter capsule with a 3 mL syringe into a 15 mL Falcon tube (lysate volume 2–3 mL). Add proteinase K at 10 µL per 100 µL lysate, vortex briefly, and incubate at 56 °C overnight.

steps.title: Add AL buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Remove the lysate from the incubator, add an equal volume of AL buffer (Qiagen), vortex for a few seconds, and incubate at 56 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add cold ethanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 99.9 % cold ethanol to the lysate‑AL mixture, vortex briefly; the final ratio of lysate : AL buffer : ethanol is 1 : 1 : 1.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column via vacuum
steps.instruction: Place a DNeasy Mini spin column in a QIAvac 24 Plus vacuum manifold, load the mixture (5–15 mL) into the tube‑extender attached to the column, and apply vacuum to allow the lysate to flow through the column.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Remove the spin column from the vacuum, place it in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, centrifuge 1 min at 6000 g (≈8000 rpm), then discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2 and dry
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a fresh 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge 1 min at 20 000 g (≈14 000 rpm), discard flow‑through and tube; then transfer the column to another collection tube and centrifuge 2 min at 17 000 g (≈13 000 rpm) to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute DNA into LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5‑ or 2‑mL DNA LoBind tube (caps removed), add 100 µL 70 °C Buffer TE (pH 8.0), incubate at room temperature for 10 min, centrifuge 1 min at 6000 g (≈8000 rpm) to collect DNA, and discard the spin column.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Nanodrop
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.
